zh-Hans: 改进 Fn 快速切换、录音启动和取消之间的衔接，避免快捷键和录音状态不同步。
同一段实时录音只提交一次，最终文本返回后，迟到的识别结果不会覆盖它。
改进 Agent 的答案复制和动作审批。确认后立即取消时，尚未启动的动作不会执行。
快速切换历史录音时，上一条的加载结果不会打断当前播放。退出前会等待重识别和已发出的文本写入完成，再保存数据。
记忆导入审核时按 Esc 会先确认是否放弃。取消分析或离开麦克风测试后，迟到的结果不会重新打开流程。
en: Improve how Fn gestures, recording startup, and cancellation work together, so shortcuts stay in sync with recording.
Submit each live recording only once and keep late recognition events from changing the final transcript.
Improve copying Agent answers and approving actions. Canceling right after approval stops actions that have not started yet.
Switching between history recordings no longer lets an earlier request interrupt playback. Quitting waits for retries and text writes already sent to their target, then saves local data.
Pressing Esc while reviewing a memory import asks before discarding your selection. Late results no longer restart a canceled import or a closed microphone test.
